schaumamoi

Event aggregation, metering and analysis for GA4 event data as produced by foomo/sesamy-go. This site is written by the project's tests: every page shows what the code actually does, computed on every run, next to the tests that check it.

Taste as a sparse vector

pkg/personalization

Shoppers and products are described in one sparse space of taste dimensions — classic, modern, cozy, festive… A product only names the dimensions that describe it, so taste carries between categories through what they share. Each category weighs the dimensions it looks at.

A corpus of events

pkg/corpus, pkg/affinity

Events are admitted and decorated once, on arrival, and read by any number of derivers. The affinity corpus admits a shopper's choices — selections, views, carts — and emits their personalization vector, which fades per choice and lets go of the past when the intent changes.

A shop to test it against

pkg/mock

Deterministic GA4 traffic from a two-department shop: personas with hidden taste browse, choose what they like and buy, request by request, while the shop ranks every listing with the vector the corpus emits for them.

How this site is made

Each package's TestReport computes its page's data from the real code and hands it to pkg/internal/docs, which holds the layout, the page templates, the charts and the styles. Build it with mise run docs: it runs the whole test suite and leaves the site in build/site, ready to publish as a GitHub Pages site. The site is not kept in version control.
